title: IVG Pro Salts Blackberry Sour Razz 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Pro Nic Salts Blackberry Sour Razz 10ml E-Liquid delivers a bold and tangy fruit experience for vapers who enjoy a sharp flavour profile. This blend leads with the deep, dark sweetness of ripe Blackberry, providing a rich foundation. This is immediately followed by the bright, acidic bite of Sour Raspberry, creating a dynamic contrast that leaves a clean, tart finish on the palate. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. IVG Pro Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits, serving as a highly cost-effective alternative to single-use or prefilled systems. The IVG Pro Salts collection takes the globally revered flavour profiles from the beloved IVG Pro prefilled pod range and makes them available in convenient 10ml bottles. As a multi-award-winning UK brand, IVG ensures exceptional quality across a massive selection of e-liquids. Beyond the sharp berry tang of Blackberry Sour Razz, vapers can explore other standout blends such as the refreshing Gum Mint or the bright Blue Raspberry Ice, ensuring a premium option for every palate.
